name: Historical Monuments at Makli, Thatta
description: Near the town of Thatta in Pakistan's Sindh province, Makli is one of the world's largest cemeteries, with monumental tombs spread across a low ridge. Built between the 14th and 18th centuries, the sandstone and brick mausoleums blend local and Islamic styles, with carved stonework and glazed tiles. Together they trace the rise of the dynasties that once ruled Sindh from Thatta.
